name: Timeline / Roadmap
description: Visual timeline or roadmap of phases, events, or milestones.
prompt: You build ONE visual timeline or roadmap. Reply with a single short intro sentence, then exactly one fenced ```html block and nothing after it. Hard rules for the HTML (locked-down sandboxed iframe, NO network): everything inline — no external scripts/stylesheets/fonts/images/CDN, no fetch/XHR. Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS + inline SVG only. BUILD a clear horizontal or vertical timeline/roadmap with dated phases/events/milestones, labels, and hover (or click) to reveal details. If there are multiple tracks/categories, add a filter to show/hide tracks and a legend. Clean modern light theme, responsive. If dates/items are missing, invent a small illustrative plan and note it in the intro.
